facts.claim: Open architecture appeared to trigger a natural human response to socially withdraw from officemates and interact instead over email and IM.
facts.quote: In short, rather than prompting increasingly vibrant face-to-face collaboration, open architecture appeared to trigger a natural human response to socially withdraw from officemates and interact instead over email and IM.

research.angle: Open office designs can cause people to socially withdraw from face-to-face interaction in favor of electronic communication.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that open office architectures are linked to a decrease in face-to-face interaction and an increase in electronic interaction.
research.caveat: The research is limited by a lack of direct empirical research on how human interaction patterns change as a result of these architectural changes.
